source: Nakashima et al. 2023, npj Microgravity 9:68 / PMC10444889

images.title: Morphology & Root Skewing in ISS Veggie
images.findings: Arabidopsis thaliana (Col-0) roots exhibit pronounced right-handed skewing and waving in microgravity aboard the ISS Veggie facility compared to straight vertical geotropic growth in 1g ground controls.

images.title: 4M KOH Glycome Profiling & Differential Readouts
images.findings: Significant spaceflight induction of tightly-bound secondary cell wall xylan epitopes (CCRC-M138/M140, +1.85 to +2.42 log2FC) alongside reorganization of xyloglucans and AGPs.

images.title: Semi-Thin Histological Root Architecture
images.findings: Semi-thin cross-sections and longitudinal slices delineate root cap, quiescent center (QC), meristematic zone, elongation zone, cortex, endodermis, and vascular stele.

images.title: Confocal IHC: Spaceflight Induction in Root Tips
images.findings: Marked increase in fluorescence intensity (+140% to +185%) for pectin RG-I (CCRC-M2), de-esterified homogalacturonan (CCRC-M50), and xyloglucan core (CCRC-M80) in spaceflight root tips.

images.title: Confocal IHC: Spaceflight Repression in Root Tips
images.findings: Significant spaceflight decline in fluorescence (-45% to -68%) for β-6-galactan (CCRC-M79), arabinogalactan AG-2 (JIM19), and pectin rhamnogalacturonan (CCRC-M123).

images.title: Confocal IHC: Maturation Cross-Sections & Xylem Xylan
images.findings: Striking, selective accumulation of unsubstituted xylan backbones (CCRC-M140) specifically within metaxylem and protoxylem vessels (+192% increase, p < 0.001) in space-grown roots.

images.title: Full Sequential Extractions Heatmaps (All 6 Fractions)
images.findings: Complete glycome heatmaps across 50mM CDTA (pectins), 1M KOH (XG matrix), 4M KOH (tight xylans), 100mM NaClO2 (lignin-associated), 4M KOHPC (residual matrix), and 0.1M H2SO4 (acid matrix).

images.title: Quantitative Polysaccharide Clade ELISA Distributions
images.findings: Statistical distribution of mean optical density across major cell wall glycan clades, confirming significant spaceflight induction in xylan and xyloglucan fractions.

images.title: Extended Root Tip Confocal IHC Panel (30+ mAbs)
images.findings: Extended immunofluorescence panel confirming fucosylated xyloglucan (CCRC-M1, CCRC-M106) elevation in the elongation zone and arabinogalactan (JIM13, MAC207) reduction in the root cap.

images.title: High-Magnification Stele vs Cortex IHC Cross-Sections
images.findings: High-resolution cross-sectional micrographs demonstrating that CCRC-M140 xylan is strictly restricted to thickened secondary walls of tracheary elements, while AGP JIM19 is distributed across outer cortical walls.

images.title: Negative Control Immunofluorescence Baselines
images.findings: Non-immune primary serum and secondary AlexaFluor-488 conjugated antibody negative controls confirm zero non-specific background binding and absence of tissue autofluorescence artifacts.

images.title: Seedling Biomass & Root Growth Kinematics
images.findings: Quantification of seedling fresh weight, dry weight, moisture content, and root elongation rates in Veggie hardware on ISS vs KSC 1g ground controls.
